title: 11. Mechanisms
keys: Which mechanisms do you value most?
A rule of how the program works: how you join, how you earn and how you reach a status.
Reach higher levels through spending and keep each level permanently once achieved, requiring higher spending to reach the level.
Reach €10,000 of total spending over the years and keep the top level for life
Rewarded for years as a member
Receive benefits for being a member for several years, regardless of spending. A long period is required to achieve that recognition.
After 5 years as a member you get a free room upgrade on every stay
Reach or maintain higher levels by meeting a spending target each year.
Spend €2,000 in a year to reach Gold. Next year you need to spend it again to keep Gold
Earn points whenever you spend money, then redeem them for rewards.
1 point for every euro spent at the hotel, restaurants and golf club
Earn rewards by completing actions, such as a discount for visiting a restaurant three times.
Stay three nights and get one free
Join through an app or website
Join by creating an account through an app or website to access benefits.
Download the resort app and sign up
Join with an email or phone number
Join by providing an email or phone number to access benefits.
Leave your email at reception to receive offers
Pay a fee to access benefits
Pay a subscription fee to access benefits.
A yearly membership at a golf club that includes your rounds
Receive recognition because you own an asset, for instance a property within the destination.
Owners of a home in the resort become members automatically
I do not mind how I earn rewards
I do not need to move up levels
Reach higher levels through spending and keep each level permanently once achieved. Everything you spend adds up over the years, with no yearly reset, and each higher level requires more spending.
Annual status levels, where you have to qualify again every year, and Recognition over time, which counts the years as a member and not the money.
Receive benefits for being a member for several years, regardless of spending. A long period is required to achieve that recognition. What counts is time, not money.
Points for spending and Lifetime status levels, which depend on how much you spend, not on how long you have been a member.
Reach or maintain higher levels by meeting a spending target each year. When the year ends you start again, so you have to meet the target again to keep your level.
Lifetime status levels, where the level never goes away, and Paid membership, where you pay for access.
Earn points whenever you spend money, then redeem them for rewards such as nights, meals or experiences, a bit like a card with rewards.
Use 5,000 points to pay for a dinner
Complete activities to earn rewards, where the reward comes from doing something a number of times and not from how much you spend.
Earn rewards by completing actions, such as a discount for visiting a restaurant three times. It does not matter how much you spend. The classic case is the coffee card: buy ten, get one free.
Play all the golf courses in the region and unlock a special round
Points for spending, where you earn points for each euro you spend.
Join by creating an account through an app or website to access benefits. You can also get a membership card, physical or digital.
Get a member card at check in
Quick sign-up with contact details, where you only share an email or phone number and do not create an account.
Join by providing an email or phone number to access benefits. No account, password or app is needed.
Create an account, where you set up an account in an app or website.
Pay a subscription fee to access benefits. You become a member straight away, without having to spend a minimum amount or visit a number of times.
A paid club card that gives you the top level from day one
Annual status levels, where you earn the level by spending instead of paying a fee.
Receive recognition because you own an asset, for instance a property within the destination. You do not need to pay a fee or join in any other way.
A shareholder of the golf club gets access to the whole program
Paid membership, where you pay a fee for access and do not need to own anything.

title: 12. Benefits
keys: Which benefits do you value most?
Something you receive or can use from the program, such as a perk or an advantage.
Benefits for the whole family, like pooling points or accessing family packages and activities.
Your children get access to the kids club with your membership
Benefits you can share, like bringing a guest to enjoy certain privileges.
Bring a friend to the golf club at member price
Personalization, like receiving recommendations and offers tailored to you.
Your preferred room and pillow ready on arrival
Convenience, like faster check-in or complimentary parking.
Late checkout or early check in
Meeting other members through social events.
Access to events (for example, tickets to a sports event), experiences or areas reserved for members.
Discounts and perks in other brands, in areas such as transport, restaurants and local experiences.
A discount with an airline or a car rental company
Flexibility when booking and paying, like the ability to combine cash and points.
Artificial intelligence that suggests activities and recommends services.
An app that builds your itinerary for you
Donating to a local community or an environmental cause.
Donate part of your points to a local cause
Services such as priority reservations or a dedicated concierge.
Benefits for the whole family, like pooling points or accessing family packages and activities. Your partner and children can use the membership too.
Family members pool their points into one account
Benefits you can share, where you bring friends and guests rather than your close family.
Benefits you can share, like bringing a guest to enjoy certain privileges. A friend can enjoy the same advantages when you bring them.
Give one of your free nights to someone else
Family benefits, which cover your close family with their own access.
Personalization, like receiving recommendations and offers tailored to you. The program remembers what you like, so you do not have to ask for the same things every time.
Offers for the activities you usually book
Convenience, like faster check-in or complimentary parking. Small perks that save you time and hassle during your stay.
Priority and exclusive services, which is about priority and personal service and not only about saving time.
Meeting other members through social events, in person or online, so you feel part of a group.
A members app to meet people
Exclusive experiences and spaces, where the point is reserved access and not meeting other members.
Access to events (for example, tickets to a sports event), experiences or areas reserved for members. It is about where you can go and what you can attend.
A reserved area at the beach club
A private dinner or tournament for members

Priority and exclusive services, which is about personal and priority service wherever you are, not reserved places. A simple way to remember: services are how you are looked after, experiences and spaces are where you can go and what you can attend.
Discounts and perks in other brands, in areas such as transport, restaurants and local experiences. The perks come from companies that work together with the program.
Offers in local restaurants and experiences from partner companies
Flexibility when booking and paying, like the ability to combine cash and points. It removes money barriers to booking, such as paying later.
Pay for a stay with part cash and part points
Artificial intelligence that suggests activities and recommends services. It helps you plan and decide by finding options and answering your questions.
A chat that suggests restaurants and books a table
Donating to a local community or an environmental cause. You can turn part of your value into positive impact, or be rewarded for making sustainable choices.
A reward for choosing a greener option
Services such as priority reservations or a dedicated concierge. It is personal and priority service that regular guests do not get, and it is about how you are looked after.
A table at a restaurant that is fully booked
Preferred tee times at the golf course

Exclusive experiences and spaces, which is about events and places reserved for members. A simple way to remember: services are how you are looked after, experiences and spaces are where you can go and what you can attend.
